packageRules.description: One PR a month for everything except majors, image digests included. Majors stay separate; security fixes ignore the schedule.

Stay on TypeScript 6. TypeScript 7 drops the JavaScript compiler API that vite-plugin-dts needs for declaration files (it would need @typescript/typescript6 as a fallback). Revisit once vite-plugin-dts supports TS 7 natively.
